parsed.explanation: Article 390 of the February 2026 penal code is a trans-specific criminal statute: it punishes with 5–10 years anyone who changes or attempts to change their sex at birth, with no mitigation or suspended sentences, and no effective remedy (judges who acquitted were reassigned or sanctioned). Enforcement is a documented coordinated campaign of arrests and imprisonment (40+ arrested, 16 imprisoned), and the surrounding climate is official hostility framed as cultural protection, with trans-adjacent care (HIV/PrEP) collapsing. No border, custody or health-facility practice for trans visitors is documented, so those edge cases stay open rather than assumed, and no death penalty or killing pattern is established — which keeps this above the 0.05 tier of near-certain imprisonment plus likely execution, but firmly in the severe band.
